answer_1.quote: We train speech-to-unit translation (S2UT) models ... the S2UT model takes source speech as input and predicts a sequence of target discrete units ... With the discrete units generated by S2UT models, we resynthesize speech using pretrained unit-based HiFi-GAN vocoders.
answer_1.outputs: target speech waveforms (synthesized from predicted discrete units)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the resynthesized speech using both transcription-based and transcription-free methods. For the transcription-based method, we transcribe the speech output using the same ASR models ... We evaluate the transcriptions using SacreBLEU to compute BLEU and chrF2++ scores. We also adopt BLASER 2.0.
